scoring_rule: Score = 2*availability + autonomy + reuse; descending score, availability, autonomy, then action ID.

criteria.availability: 3 joined inputs; 2 partial joins; 1 major gaps; 0 absent.
criteria.autonomy: 3 local completion; 2 useful local preparation; 1 substantial specialist access; 0 new fieldwork.
criteria.reuse: 3 foundational across themes; 2 several questions; 1 one question; 0 speculative.

selection: Ranks bounded additional work with current holdings. Rows marked Limited are excluded. Preparing evidence is distinguished from completing the entire recommendation.
